title: Senior Key Account & Retail Development Manager DE & AT (m/w/d)
description: Team und Verantwortlichkeiten ​​​​ Build Partnerships. Create Growth. Make an Impact. Recovery zählt zu den am schnellsten wachsenden Kategorien im Sportfachhandel. Seit mehr als 20 Jahren gestaltet BLACKROLL® diesen Markt aktiv mit und hat gemeinsam mit führenden Handelspartnern in Deutschland und Österreich eine der stärksten Premium-Marken der Kategorie aufgebaut. Jetzt suchen wir eine unternehmerisch denkende Vertriebspersönlichkeit, die mit Leidenschaft bestehendes Geschäft weiterentwickelt, neue kommerzielle Potenziale erschließt und gemeinsam mit unseren Handelspartnern die Zukunft des Handels aktiv mitgestaltet. Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit einer pragmatischen Hands-on-Mentalität und verwandelst Ideen in messbaren kommerziellen Erfolg. Du hinterfragst den Status quo, erkennst Wachstumspotenziale und schaffst dort echten Impact, wo andere nur Routine sehen. Deine Mission Du übernimmst die kommerzielle Verantwortung für die strategisch wichtigsten Handelspartner von BLACKROLL® in Deutschland und Österreich. Deine Mission ist es, bestehendes Geschäft auszubauen, neue Produktkategorien und Retail-Konzepte erfolgreich im Markt zu etablieren und kommerzielle Chancen zu identifizieren, die langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere Kunden und für BLACKROLL® schaffen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Trade Marketing, B2B Marketing und bereichsübergreifenden Teams verwandelst Du ambitionierte Ideen in exzellente Retail-Umsetzung und nachhaltiges Wachstum. Deine Verantwortlichkeiten Strategische Key-Account-Verantwortung Du betreust und entwickelst ein Portfolio strategischer Retail-Accounts in Deutschland und Österreich und baust langfristige Partnerschaften sowie nachhaltige Wachstumspläne auf. Umsatz-, Forecast- und kommerzielle Planung Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für die jährliche Umsatzplanung, Forecasts, Budgetsteuerung und die kommerzielle Performance deines Kundenportfolios. Joint Business Planning & Trade Activation Du entwickelst und setzt gemeinsam mit Retail-Partnern jährliche Business-Pläne um, inklusive Promotions, Kampagnen, Produktlaunches und kommerzieller Wachstumsinitiativen. Retail Excellence & POS-Entwicklung Gemeinsam mit dem Trade-Marketing-Team treibst du den Rollout, die Optimierung und den Ausbau der Premium-Retail-Konzepte von BLACKROLL voran – inklusive Zweitplatzierungen, gebrandeter Flächen und In-Store-Erlebnissen. Sell-in- & Sell-out-Performance-Management Du analysierst und verbesserst die Account-Performance durch datengetriebenes Account Management, Sell-out-Initiativen, Sortimentsoptimierung und enge Zusammenarbeit mit Retail-Partnern. Kategorie- & Produktausbau Du identifizierst Potenziale, um neue BLACKROLL Produktkategorien und Lösungen erfolgreich in bestehenden und neuen Retail-Kanälen einzuführen und zu skalieren. New Business Development im Retail Du gewinnst und entwickelst neue strategische Retail-Partner in priorisierten Segmenten wie Sports Retail, Healthcare Retail und Sleep Retail. Cross-funktionale kommerzielle Führung Du agierst als zentrale kommerzielle Schnittstelle zwischen Kund und internen Teams und arbeitest eng mit Trade Marketing, B2B Marketing, Supply Chain und Produktmanagement zusammen, um eine bestmögliche Umsetzung sicherzustellen. Dein Profil Du bringst 7 - 10 Jahre Erfahrung im Key Account Management, Sales oder Retail Business Development mit - idealerweise in Sports Retail, Consumer Goods, Health & Wellness oder verwandten Branchen. Du hast nachweisbare Erfolge im Management und Ausbau strategischer Retail-Accounts erzielt. Du verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung in Jahresplanung, Forecasting, Budgetsteuerung und kommerziellen Verhandlungen. Du hast erfolgreich Sell-in-, Sell-out- und Retail-Performance-Initiativen umgesetzt. Du arbeitest sicher mit Trade Marketing und Marketing zusammen, um Retail-Aktivierungen, Kampagnen und Promotions wirkungsvoll umzusetzen. Du hast ein starkes Verständnis für Retail Operations, POS Excellence und eine hochwertige Markenpräsentation. Du überzeugst durch Hands-on-Mentalität, Ownership, Umsetzungsstärke sowie sehr gute Kommunikations-, Stakeholder- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten. Du denkst strategisch, erkennst Wachstumspotenziale und übersetzt sie in kommerzielle Ergebnisse; ein bestehendes Netzwerk im deutschen und österreichischen Retail ist ein klarer Vorteil. Das erwartet dich bei uns Wir haben viel Raum für Regeneration und zum Krafttanken geschaffen. Unter anderem 6 Wochen Urlaub, Home-Office Regelung und flexible Arbeitszeiten. Bewusste Phasen der Aktivierung sind bei uns fester Bestandteil in einem Office, indem wir gesundes Arbeiten umsetzen. Wir lieben unseren Standort, der uns einen wunderbaren Ausblick auf den See und die damit verbundenen Benefits bietet. Unsere Arbeit in Rollen zeichnet sich durch Transparenz, klare Verantwortlichkeiten und selbstverantwortliches Handeln aus. Interner und externer Wissensaustausch wird gefördert und ermöglicht uns eine permanente gemeinsame Entwicklung. Wir haben viel Spass zusammen. Zudem übernehmen wir als Arbeitgeber 70% der Pensionskassenbeiträge und unsere Mitarbeitenden geniessen Produktrabatte intern sowie bei externen Partnern. Aufgrund der Reisetätigkeit dieser Position unterstützen wir Dich mit einer passenden Mobilitätslösung, beispielsweise in Form eines Firmenwagens oder einer Car Allowance. Über das angegebene Einstiegsgehalt hinaus berücksichtigen wir Deine Erfahrung, Qualifikation und nachweisbaren Erfolge mit einer entsprechend attraktiven Vergütung. Bereit, Retail Growth aktiv zu gestalten? Wenn Du strategische Handelspartner nicht nur betreuen, sondern aktiv entwickeln willst – und Lust hast, BLACKROLL® im Retail sichtbar, relevant und kommerziell erfolgreich weiter auszubauen - freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung. Ein klassisches Motivationsschreiben brauchst Du nicht. Spannender für uns sind Deine Erfahrungen, Deine Herangehensweise und Dein Impact. Bitte beantworte uns kurz folgende Fragen: Wie hast Du in der Vergangenheit strategische Retail Accounts nachhaltig entwickelt und Wachstum erzielt? Beschreibe ein Beispiel, bei dem Du Sell-in, Sell-out oder POS-Performance messbar verbessert hast. Welche Hebel hast Du genutzt? Welche Chancen siehst Du für BLACKROLL® im deutschen und österreichischen Retail - und wie würdest Du diese angehen? Dein Ansprechpartner Hast du Fragen? Ich bin dein Ansprechpartner aus dem People & Culture Team. Ich freue mich, wenn du dich für unser Unternehmen interessierst und beantworte gerne alle deine Fragen rund ums Thema arbeiten bei BLACKROLL®. raw.title: Working Student - Logistics (f/m/d)
raw.description:
At Instagrid, you are part of the clean-tech revolution by bringing pure energy into your region, helping professional workers transitioning away from combustion generators and making it possible for them to experience a safe, efficient, clean and silent energy solution.

Your Mission

Instagrid ships hardware — globally, at volume, to customers who expect their orders to arrive on time and on spec. As a Working Student in Logistics, you keep that promise. You are the operational backbone of our internal shipping area: handling incoming and outgoing goods, managing documentation, coordinating carriers, and serving as the link between physical goods movement and the Sales and Customer Management teams who need accurate, real-time information to do their jobs.

This is an on-site role in Ludwigsburg. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with our Operations team — expect to spend real time on the warehouse floor, not behind a screen.

Your Impact

  • Incoming goods: Receive and verify deliveries against purchase orders, create item receipts in NetSuite, and flag discrepancies without delay

  • Outgoing goods: Pick, pack, and dispatch finished goods and spare parts accurately and on time, in line with customer orders and internal shipping requests

  • Carrier management: Select the right carrier and service level for each shipment, book collections, and keep carrier accounts and documentation up to date

  • Order fulfilment: Coordinate daily with our external warehouse partner to ensure all market demands are serviced without gaps

  • Returns processing: Unpack, inspect, and document customer returns; hand over items to quality or repair workflows with full traceability

  • Shipping documentation: Produce commercial invoices, packing lists, and delivery notes accurately and in a timely manner

  • Tracking and visibility: Keep Sales and Customer Management proactively informed on shipment status, resolve carrier exceptions early, and escalate delays before they reach the customer

  • Warehouse housekeeping: Maintain clean, labelled, and accurately stocked storage locations in line with our ERP records

  • Currently enrolled in logistics, supply chain management, business administration, or a related degree program

  • Reliable and committed to showing up — this is a fixed on-site role that requires consistent coordination around your university timetable

  • Precise and structured in everything you do: in logistics, a documentation error is not a minor mistake — it has consequences, and you know that

  • A proactive communicator who raises issues and shares updates without needing to be prompted

  • Confident using digital tools: ERP systems, carrier portals, and spreadsheets are part of your daily workflow

  • Fluent in German and English — both are essential for working with carriers, partners, and customers

Your Benefits

  • Real responsibility from day one — not busywork, but genuine ownership of live shipping operations

  • End-to-end exposure: from goods receipt and carrier selection through order fulfilment to returns and customer visibility

  • A lean, hands-on team that gives direct feedback and expects you to speak up when something isn't right

  • An inside view of what it takes to scale a hardware company — across operations, supply chain, and beyond

  • Flexible working hours coordinated around your university schedule

  • Generous holiday entitlement plus additional special leave days, on a pro-rata basis

This is Instagrid

Pure instant power. Anywhere. We have created the world’s most advanced portable power supplies, bringing freedom to the way our customers work. With you we want to shape a world where advanced technology meets environmental responsibility and create lasting impact. Driven by our curiosity and the desire to leave tomorrow's world cleaner than we found it yesterday. Join us in transitioning away from combustion generators to a cleaner alternative for fast, measurable, and real outcomes. What we’ve achieved so far is just the beginning.

At Instagrid, we are deeply committed to equal employment opportunities as we believe in the power of diverse teams. We do not just accept diversity but actively search for the best talent regardless of gender, ethnic origin, age, religion, sexual orientation or place of origin. Working as a team, we treat each other with respect and value each other’s opinions to achieve our common goals.

We are looking forward to receiving your application!

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer – EO/IR Gimbal Systems (m/f/d)
description: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Embedded Software Engineer to lead the development of software for next-generation defense-grade Electro-Optical/Infrared (EO/IR) gimbal systems. The successful candidate will architect and develop high-performance, low-latency video processing and streaming software for embedded computing platforms while integrating cameras, sensors, communication interfaces, and embedded hardware into a mission-critical stabilization and targeting system. This role requires strong expertise in embedded Linux, multimedia frameworks, GPU-accelerated computing, networking, and hardware/software integration. You will collaborate closely with systems, electronics, computer vision, mechanical, and control engineers to deliver robust, production-ready solutions for demanding defense applications. What is your Day to Day Mission: Design, develop, and maintain embedded software for defense-grade EO/IR gimbal systems. Develop real-time video capture, processing, encoding, decoding, recording, and streaming applications on embedded Linux platforms using GStreamer, FFmpeg, and hardware-accelerated multimedia frameworks. Develop reliable networking solutions for real-time video transport using RTP, RTSP, UDP, TCP, H.264, and H.265. Develop high-performance image processing and computer vision applications using CUDA, OpenCV, or equivalent GPU-accelerated technologies where applicable. Integrate visible, infrared, and thermal imaging sensors into embedded systems. Develop software interfaces for IMUs, laser rangefinders, and other mission-critical sensors. Develop Linux device drivers and perform kernel-level integration for custom hardware. Interface with embedded hardware using SPI, I²C, UART, CAN, GPIO, USB, Ethernet, MIPI CSI, HDMI, and other industry-standard interfaces. Optimize software for deterministic performance, low latency, and efficient utilization of CPU, GPU, and hardware accelerators. Design scalable communication architectures between embedded processors, payload controllers, flight controllers, and external systems. Support hardware bring-up, integration, debugging, verification, and field testing. Implement logging features and analyze issues reported by testing and customers Produce software architecture documentation, interface specifications, and technical documentation. Participate in system architecture, design reviews, and technology roadmap planning. What you bring to the team: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Robotics, or a related discipline. 5+ years of professional experience developing embedded software for Linux-based systems. Strong expertise in Embedded Linux application development. Experience with Linux kernel development, device drivers, and hardware abstraction layers. Strong C/C++ and/or Rust programming skills. Experience with GStreamer and/or FFmpeg multimedia frameworks for low-latency, high-performance multimedia and video streaming applications. Experience with H.264/H.265 video codecs and streaming technologies including RTSP, RTP, UDP, and TCP. Experience integrating embedded peripherals using SPI, UART, I²C, CAN, GPIO, USB, Ethernet, and similar interfaces. Experience integrating imaging sensors and peripherals such as IMUs, GPS, encoders, or similar devices. Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and troubleshooting in embedded or distributed systems. Experience with hardware/software integration and embedded system debugging. Familiarity with GPU computing, OpenCV, CUDA, or equivalent hardware acceleration technologies. Experience with Git, CMake, cross-compilation, and embedded Linux development workflows. Strong systems thinking with an understanding of software architecture and hardware/software interface design. Why Quantum-Systems: We believe in the power of combined efforts: straightforward tech expertise paired with a customer-centric focus. We are industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. We push limits, think outside-the-box and strive for technological excellence to shape the future of aerial data. We promise to be your runway for individual and professional growth. Our benefits: Company pension scheme: We support you so that you can already make provisions for later. Flexible working hours: With trust-based working hours, you are not only responsible for your working hours, but also for your work-life balance. Mobile Work: If things get a little busy in the office, you have the option to work remotely one flexible day per week to create the right balance. Stay active: With EGYM Wellpass, you get access to thousands of fitness and sports facilities — and of course, we subsidize the membership. Bike-Leasing: We support you in staying environmentally mobile and healthy. title: Projektmanager*in Kooperationen
description: Job Description is only in German, as the Job requires proficiency in German language. Klub44 ist ein gemeinnütziges Startup im Bereich digitale Jugendbeteiligung. Mit der Klub-App ermöglichen wir es jungen Menschen, ihre eigene Stadt und ihre Vorlieben zu entdecken, und die Welt um sich herum mitzugestalten. Alle jungen Menschen haben das Recht auf ein freies und schöpferisches Leben, daran glauben wir fest. Nebenbei möchten wir die Schul- und Berufsbildung radikal transformieren. Mit der Klub-App erhalten Jugendliche ab 12 Jahren einen chancengerechten Zugang zu kostenfreien Freizeit- und Berufsorientierungsangeboten. Außerschulische Standorte – z. B. Jugendclubs, Makerspaces, Orte der kulturellen Bildung – können auf unserer App ihre Angebote direkt und digital an Jugendliche kommunizieren. Das Ganze bauen wir als Game auf: Entdecke deine Stadt, dich selbst, und bekomme dafür Rewards! Wir ermutigen ausdrücklich Menschen aller Geschlechter, Religionen und sexuellen Orientierungen dazu, sich bei uns zu bewerben! Aufgaben Als Projektmanager*in Kooperationen bist du die Person, bei der unsere operativen Projekte zusammenlaufen. Kommunen, Schulen und Stiftungen arbeiten mit uns, weil sie ein Ergebnis wollen – du sorgst dafür, dass dieses Ergebnis auch eintritt: im Zeitplan, im Budget, und mit zufriedenen Partnern. Gleichzeitig hast du einen zweiten Auftrag, der genauso wichtig ist: Du führst so viele Projekte wie möglich über unsere Standardprozesse, damit Klub als Plattform skalierbar bleibt und nicht in Sonderlösungen erstickt. Diese Doppelrolle – nach außen verbindlich, nach innen konsequent – ist der Kern des Jobs. Wir freuen uns auf Mitunternehmer*innen, um gemeinsam mit dem jungen Team und Geschäftsführer Sebastian die Geschicke von Klub44 zu leiten. Projektsteuerung Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung unserer laufenden Kooperationsprojekte – von Kick-off bis Abschluss. Planung von Meilensteinen, Verantwortlichkeiten und Terminen; Nachhalten, wenn es hakt. Frühzeitiges Erkennen von Risiken und aktives Gegensteuern, statt Überraschungen am Projektende. Sicherstellen, dass zugesagte Ziele (z. B. teilnehmende Standorte, aktive Jugendliche, Angebots-Uploads) tatsächlich erreicht werden. Account Management & Partnerbetreuung Du bist die verlässliche Ansprechperson für unsere Projektpartner in Kommunen, Schulen und Stiftungen – die Stimme von Klub im Alltag. Aufbau langfristiger Beziehungen: Bestehende Kooperationen erfolgreich umsetzen, verlängern und ausbauen. Erwartungsmanagement mit Verwaltungen, Schulleitungen und Förderpartnern: klar sagen, was geht, und was nicht. Übersetzungsarbeit zwischen kommunaler Logik und Startup-Tempo – in beide Richtungen. Skalierbarkeit & Standardprozesse Onboarding von Kommunen, Schulen und Jugendeinrichtungen entlang unserer Standardprozesse – wiederholbar statt jedes Mal neu. Weiterentwicklung dieser Prozesse: Playbooks, Templates, Checklisten, Automatisierungen. Erkennen, wann eine Partneranfrage ein Sonderfall ist – und wann sie in ein neues Standardangebot gehört. Bewusstes Nein zu Individuallösungen, die uns langfristig teuer werden. Zahlen, Reporting & Wirkung Nachhalten der Projekt-KPIs und transparentes internes Reporting zum Projektstatus. Aufbereitung von Projektständen und Wirkungsdaten für Zuwendungsgeber und Stiftungen – die Verantwortung für Verwendungsnachweise und Reportings liegt bei der Geschäftsführung, du lieferst die Grundlage. Ableiten konkreter Maßnahmen aus den Zahlen, nicht nur Dokumentation. Zusammenarbeit im Team Enge Abstimmung mit Geschäftsführung, Marketing & Community und Produktentwicklung. Rückkopplung von Partner-Feedback ins Produkt: Was brauchen Kommunen und Standorte wirklich? Steuerung externer Partner und Dienstleister im Projektkontext. Qualifikation Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und bringst Projekte nachweislich zum Abschluss – idealerweise mit Partnern aus Verwaltung, Bildung, Stiftungen oder NGOs. Arbeitserfahrung in einem Startup ist ein guter Bonus. Du bist stark in Kooperation und Kommunikation: Du gewinnst Menschen für gemeinsame Ziele und behältst dabei die Interessen von Klub im Blick. Du denkst in Prozessen und Systemen, nicht in Einzelfällen – und hast Freude daran, Wiederholbares zu bauen. Du arbeitest strukturiert und verbindlich: Zusagen, Fristen und Follow-ups sitzen bei dir. Du bist "hands on" und sicher im Umgang mit agilen Methoden und Projektmanagement-Tools. Du arbeitest datenbasiert und bist sicher im Nachhalten von Kennzahlen. Dich motivieren unternehmerische Herausforderungen und du möchtest persönlich dazu beitragen, Jugendliche bei einer chancengerechten Entfaltung ihrer Potenziale zu fördern. Du hast sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse. Benefits Als junges, gemeinnütziges Startup sind wir noch limitiert, wollen aber mittelfristig marktgerecht zahlen. Bis wir das hinkriegen, können wir auch kreativ sein. Jugendclubs, Makerspaces, Orte der kulturellen Bildung – können auf unserer App ihre Angebote direkt und digital an Jugendliche kommunizieren. Das Ganze bauen wir als Game auf: Entdecke deine Stadt, dich selbst, und bekomme dafür Rewards!

Wir ermutigen ausdrücklich Menschen aller Geschlechter, Religionen und sexuellen Orientierungen dazu, sich bei uns zu bewerben!

Aufgaben

Als Projektmanager*in Kooperationen bist du die Person, bei der unsere operativen Projekte zusammenlaufen. Kommunen, Schulen und Stiftungen arbeiten mit uns, weil sie ein Ergebnis wollen – du sorgst dafür, dass dieses Ergebnis auch eintritt: im Zeitplan, im Budget, und mit zufriedenen Partnern. Gleichzeitig hast du einen zweiten Auftrag, der genauso wichtig ist: Du führst so viele Projekte wie möglich über unsere Standardprozesse, damit Klub als Plattform skalierbar bleibt und nicht in Sonderlösungen erstickt. Diese Doppelrolle – nach außen verbindlich, nach innen konsequent – ist der Kern des Jobs.

Wir freuen uns auf Mitunternehmer*innen, um gemeinsam mit dem jungen Team und Geschäftsführer Sebastian die Geschicke von Klub44 zu leiten.

Projektsteuerung

  • Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung unserer laufenden Kooperationsprojekte – von Kick-off bis Abschluss.
  • Planung von Meilensteinen, Verantwortlichkeiten und Terminen; Nachhalten, wenn es hakt.
  • Frühzeitiges Erkennen von Risiken und aktives Gegensteuern, statt Überraschungen am Projektende.
  • Sicherstellen, dass zugesagte Ziele (z. B. teilnehmende Standorte, aktive Jugendliche, Angebots-Uploads) tatsächlich erreicht werden.

Account Management & Partnerbetreuung

  • Du bist die verlässliche Ansprechperson für unsere Projektpartner in Kommunen, Schulen und Stiftungen – die Stimme von Klub im Alltag.
  • Aufbau langfristiger Beziehungen: Bestehende Kooperationen erfolgreich umsetzen, verlängern und ausbauen.
  • Erwartungsmanagement mit Verwaltungen, Schulleitungen und Förderpartnern: klar sagen, was geht, und was nicht.
  • Übersetzungsarbeit zwischen kommunaler Logik und Startup-Tempo – in beide Richtungen.

Skalierbarkeit & Standardprozesse

  • Onboarding von Kommunen, Schulen und Jugendeinrichtungen entlang unserer Standardprozesse – wiederholbar statt jedes Mal neu.
  • Weiterentwicklung dieser Prozesse: Playbooks, Templates, Checklisten, Automatisierungen.
  • Erkennen, wann eine Partneranfrage ein Sonderfall ist – und wann sie in ein neues Standardangebot gehört.
  • Bewusstes Nein zu Individuallösungen, die uns langfristig teuer werden.

Zahlen, Reporting & Wirkung

  • Nachhalten der Projekt-KPIs und transparentes internes Reporting zum Projektstatus.
  • Aufbereitung von Projektständen und Wirkungsdaten für Zuwendungsgeber und Stiftungen – die Verantwortung für Verwendungsnachweise und Reportings liegt bei der Geschäftsführung, du lieferst die Grundlage.
  • Ableiten konkreter Maßnahmen aus den Zahlen, nicht nur Dokumentation.

Zusammenarbeit im Team

  • Enge Abstimmung mit Geschäftsführung, Marketing & Community und Produktentwicklung.
  • Rückkopplung von Partner-Feedback ins Produkt: Was brauchen Kommunen und Standorte wirklich?
  • Steuerung externer Partner und Dienstleister im Projektkontext.

Qualifikation

  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und bringst Projekte nachweislich zum Abschluss – idealerweise mit Partnern aus Verwaltung, Bildung, Stiftungen oder NGOs. Arbeitserfahrung in einem Startup ist ein guter Bonus.
  • Du bist stark in Kooperation und Kommunikation: Du gewinnst Menschen für gemeinsame Ziele und behältst dabei die Interessen von Klub im Blick.
  • Du denkst in Prozessen und Systemen, nicht in Einzelfällen – und hast Freude daran, Wiederholbares zu bauen.
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und verbindlich: Zusagen, Fristen und Follow-ups sitzen bei dir.
  • Du bist "hands on" und sicher im Umgang mit agilen Methoden und Projektmanagement-Tools.
  • Du arbeitest datenbasiert und bist sicher im Nachhalten von Kennzahlen.
  • Dich motivieren unternehmerische Herausforderungen und du möchtest persönlich dazu beitragen, Jugendliche bei einer chancengerechten Entfaltung ihrer Potenziale zu fördern.
  • Du hast sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse.

title: Junior Marketing & Sales Manager*in (m/f/d)
description: Mach etwas, worauf du stolz bist. Du möchtest eine gesellschaftlich relevante Marke aufbauen, ihre Geschichte überzeugend erzählen und genau die Menschen dafür gewinnen, die mit Parto wirklich etwas verändern können? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Parto ist die digitale All-in-one-Zahlungslösung für Sozial- und Pflegeeinrichtungen. Wir digitalisieren Bargeld- und Zahlungsprozesse, reduzieren Verwaltungsaufwand und schaffen so mehr Zeit für Menschen. Deine Aufgabe ist es, diese Mission sichtbar zu machen, neue Kund für Parto zu begeistern und unser Wachstum aktiv mitzugestalten. Aufgaben Als Junior Marketing & Sales Manager*in sorgst du dafür, dass Parto im Markt sichtbar wird, die richtigen Zielgruppen erreicht und aus Aufmerksamkeit konkrete Vertriebschancen entstehen. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Sales-Team zusammen und begleitest potenzielle Kund vom ersten Kontakt bis zur Übergabe in den weiteren Vertriebsprozess. Marketing & Content Du planst und betreust unsere Website und Social-Media-Kanäle, insbesondere LinkedIn. Du entwickelst einen strukturierten Content-Plan und erstellst relevante, zielgruppengerechte Inhalte. Du konzipierst, erstellst und versendest Newsletter und Marketingkampagnen. Prospecting & Neukundenansprache Du identifizierst relevante Zielunternehmen und recherchierst die passenden Ansprechpartner. Du sprichst potenzielle Kund proaktiv per Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn an. Du führst Cold Calls, qualifizierst erste Bedarfe und vereinbarst Gespräche für unser Sales-Team. Du entwickelst unterschiedliche Ansprachen und Kampagnen für unsere relevanten Zielgruppen. CRM & Sales Operations Du pflegst Kontakte, Aktivitäten und Vertriebschancen sorgfältig in unserem CRM-System. Du stellst eine hohe Datenqualität sicher und unterstützt uns bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer CRM-Prozesse. Du sorgst dafür, dass Leads strukturiert nachverfolgt und zum richtigen Zeitpunkt angesprochen werden. Events & Networking Du planst und organisierst Messeauftritte, Networking-Events und die Teilnahme an Anwendertreffen. Du koordinierst interne Teams, externe Partner und organisatorische Abläufe. Du unterstützt bei der Ansprache von Teilnehmenden sowie bei der strukturierten Nachbereitung gewonnener Kontakte. Analyse & Weiterentwicklung Du trackst die Wirkung unserer Marketing- und Sales-Aktivitäten anhand relevanter KPIs. Du analysierst Kampagnen, Kanäle und Ansprachen und leitest daraus konkrete Verbesserungsmaßnahmen ab. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein und hilfst uns, skalierbare Marketing- und Sales-Prozesse für das weitere Wachstum von Parto aufzubauen. Qualifikation Du bist eine kommunikations- und vertriebsstarke Persönlichkeit mit hoher Eigenmotivation . Du hast Freude daran, potenzielle Kund für eine relevante Lösung zu begeistern, überzeugende Inhalte zu entwickeln und messbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen. title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (all genders)
description: Introduction FACT-Finder builds product discovery technology for eCommerce and is trusted by leading online shops across Europe with its two products Next Generation and Infinity. Both products are moving toward a modern, hybrid platform based on Kubernetes and Harvester – with the option to scale fully into the cloud in the mid-term. As a Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), you make sure our systems stay fast, available, and scalable throughout this transformation. You work closely with the Hosting team and experienced engineers, and actively shape our journey toward a modern SaaS company. Your mission You define and own SLOs, SLIs, and error budgets across both products and make data-driven decisions on reliability and performance. You drive incident response: fast detection, clear communication, blameless postmortems, and meaningful follow-through. You consistently reduce manual work through automation and GitOps (e.g. Argo CD / Flux) and build out self-healing and self-service capabilities. You support the development of an NG Search Operator (custom Kubernetes operator / CRDs) and the rollout of auto-scaling (HPA, VPA, KEDA, cluster autoscaler). You evolve our observability – metrics, logs, traces, alerting, and runbooks that actually help on call. You plan capacity and cost across on-premise (Frankfurt, Stockholm) and cloud – including burst scenarios into the public cloud. You leverage AI tools to noticeably accelerate diagnosis, alerting, and operational workflows. Your profile Experience as an SRE, infrastructure, or production engineer in a SaaS or platform environment – or a strong software/operations background with a clear drive to grow into an SRE role. Solid understanding of SLOs, error budgets, incident management, and observability. Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and interest in cluster lifecycle, upgrades, and operator patterns. Experience with or strong interest in Harvester or comparable HCI/virtualization platforms (KubeVirt, vSphere/ESXi, OpenStack). Familiarity with GitOps (Argo CD / Flux), container storage (Longhorn, Ceph), and Kubernetes networking (load balancing, ingress). Knowledge of auto-scaling primitives (HPA, VPA, cluster autoscaler, KEDA) and capacity planning on-prem and in the cloud. Understanding of networking in production-grade datacenters (incl. VLAN). A strong automation instinct and a mindset to structurally eliminate toil. Practical experience using AI tools in day-to-day operations. Fluent English; German is a plus. THE JOY OF WORKING WITH US Impact from day one: Your work directly influences the revenue of leading eCommerce brands across Europe. Modern tech stack: Kubernetes, Harvester, GitOps, auto-scaling, and an exciting path toward the cloud – with room to build things right. AI-first mindset: We use AI as a real part of our daily work, not as a buzzword. Ownership & growth: Clear responsibility, short decision paths, and the opportunity to actively shape your role. Flexible work: Hybrid work model with a focus on outcomes. Strong team: Experienced engineers, an open feedback culture, and an environment where reliability is treated as a real engineering discipline. title: Senior Performance Marketing Manager – Performance Marketing, MMM & AI (m/w/d)
description: Du hast den kompletten Performance-Marketing-Mix fest im Griff und nutzt KI im Kampagnenmanagement nicht als Hype, sondern als tägliches Werkzeug? Du möchtest datengetriebene Entscheidungen zur Budgetallokation treffen und aktiv mitgestalten, wie modernste AI-Tools die Steuerung im E-Commerce revolutionieren? Dann wartet in unserem Team in Berlin deine nächste große Challenge auf dich: Bei benuta übernimmst du echte Ownership über unsere Kanäle hinweg und treibst ein echtes Greenfield-Thema voran – die Skalierung KI-gestützter Analysen und Strategien für den europäischen Marktführer im Home-&-Living-Bereich! Deine Aufgaben Strategische Kanal- & Budgetsteuerung: Du entwickelst und verantwortest die kanalübergreifende Performance-Marketing-Strategie via MMM zur Erreichung unserer Unternehmensziele (Umsatz, Effizienz, Lead-Gen, Brand Awareness). Du steuerst und optimierst Kampagnen über Google Ads, Bing Ads, Meta, Pinterest, Reddit Ads sowie Affiliate-Partnerschaften mit einer konsistenten Budget- und Ziellogik. AI-Integration & Workflow-Innovation: Du treibst den Einsatz von LLMs (z. B. Claude, Gemini) für die automatisierte, kanalübergreifende Analyse unserer Kampagnendaten aktiv voran. Du entwickelst Prompts und Workflows für beschleunigtes Reporting, Anomalie-Erkennung sowie Budget-Optimierungen und agierst als interner Expert für KI-gestützte Marketing-Tools. Analyse & Bidding-Evaluierung: Du überwachst und analysierst alle relevanten KPIs (CPO, ROAS, CAC, Conversion Rate) auf Basis von GA4 und unserem serverseitigen Tracking-Setup (server-side GTM). Zudem bewertest du KI-gestützte Bidding- und Automatisierungsfunktionen der Werbeplattformen auf ihren Mehrwert. Tracking-Setup & Datensicherheit: Du implementierst und verwaltest Tracking-Setups (z. B. Conversion-APIs, UTM-Konventionen) und stellst eine saubere, datenschutzkonforme Datengrundlage sicher. Testing: Du verantwortest fortlaufende A/B-Tests und Budget-Experimente zur kontinuierlichen Performance-Steigerung aller Kanäle. Partner-Management & Kollaboration: Du verhandelst und entwickelst Vendor- und Partnerverträge (z. B. im Affiliate-Bereich) weiter. Bei der Kampagnenabstimmung arbeitest du eng mit den Teams aus Design, Content und IT zusammen. Mentoring: Du unterstützt bei der fachlichen Anleitung sowie dem Onboarding von Junior-Kolleg*innen im Team und teilst dein KI-Wissen. Dein Profil Ausbildung: Du hast dein Studium (BWL, Marketing, Medien, Kommunikationswissenschaften o. Ä.) erfolgreich abgeschlossen oder bringst eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit. Relevante Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Performance Marketing mit – idealerweise kanalübergreifend (SEA, Paid Social, Affiliate) und mit nachweisbarer Budget- oder Teilprojektverantwortung. Erste Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung ist von Vorteil. AI-Expertise (Must-have): Du besitzt praxiserprobte Erfahrung im Einsatz von KI-Tools und LLMs im Marketing-Kontext (z. B. Prompting für Reporting, Analysen, Forecasting). Du verfolgst aktuelle AI-Trends aktiv und brennst darauf, diese bei benuta einzubringen. Hard Skills: Du zeichnest dich durch ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten aus, nutzt GA4 sowie gängige Attributions-/Reporting-Tools souverän und hast tiefe Kenntnisse in mindestens einem Zentralkanal (Google Ads, Meta). Erfahrung mit Bing, Pinterest, Reddit, Affiliate und serverseitigem Tracking runden dein Profil ab. Soft Skills: Du arbeitest datengetrieben, denkst lösungsorientiert und begeisterst dich für E-Commerce sowie die Themen Home & Living. Sprachkompetenz: Deine Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sind sehr gut (weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus). Deine Benefits Impact & Gestaltungsspielraum : Bei uns kannst du aktiv mitgestalten, die Marke benuta weiterentwickeln und spannende KI-Projekte umsetzen – wie etwa den Aufbau KI-gestützter Analyse-Workflows für unsere Kampagnendaten. Deine Ideen werden gehört und du bekommst Freiraum für die Umsetzung eigener Ansätze. Präsenz & Flexibilität: Der Schwerpunkt unserer Arbeit liegt auf dem persönlichen Austausch und der gemeinsamen Zusammenarbeit vor Ort an unserem Standort in Berlin. Für die nötige Flexibilität in deiner Alltagsplanung - sei es für private Termine oder ungestörtes Arbeiten - bieten wir dir ein jährliches Kontingent von 26 Home-Office-Tagen. Deine Mobilität: Egal wie du zu uns kommst, wir unterstützen dich. Du hast die Wahl zwischen einem vergünstigten Jobticket oder einer Tankkarte. Zudem bieten wir dir ein Firmenrad-Leasing (JobRad) und eine gute ÖPNV-Anbindung. Zeit für Erholung: Du erhältst 28 Tage Urlaub und profitierst von unserem flexiblen Gleitzeitmodell. Weihnachten und Silvester sind bei uns grundsätzlich arbeitsfreie Tage, die nicht von deinem Urlaubskonto abgehen. Deine Entwicklung: Unsere unterschiedlichen Abteilungen mit internationalen Teams arbeiten an vielfältigen Projekten zusammen. Dadurch lernst Du permanent neue Sichtweisen, Tools und Prozesse kennen – inklusive aktuellster KI-Anwendungen im Performance Marketing. Kultur & Mitarbeitervorteile: Ein strukturiertes Onboarding, flache Hierarchien und attraktive Mitarbeiterrabatte warten auf dich. Bei uns gilt: Come as you are – fühl dich wohl und sei einfach du selbst! Klingt nach deinem nächsten Match? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! Lade einfach deinen Lebenslauf und deine relevanten Zeugnisse über unser Online-Portal hoch. Dein Ansprechpartner ist Michael Stanke (Head of Online Marketing) . *Bei uns zählt der Mensch und seine Motivation - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion oder sexueller Orientierung. Bewerbungen von Menschen mit einer Schwerbehinderung oder ihnen Gleichgestellten werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt. Über benuta Seit 2008 revolutionieren wir von Bonn aus den europäischen Teppich- und Home-&-Living-E-Commerce. Mit über 100 Millionen Euro Umsatz, modernster AI-gestützter Produktinszenierung und Kunden in 17 Ländern verbinden wir die Sicherheit eines etablierten Marktführers mit dem Drive und den flachen Hierarchien eines Digital-Pioneers. Unser Ziel ist einfach: Jedes Zuhause noch schöner zu machen. Werde Teil unseres Teams und hilf uns dabei, noch mehr Menschen für unsere Produkte zu begeistern. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Discretionary bonus opportunity</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Hybrid Working (FlexModes)</span></li> <li Job description

We are looking for a Senior AI-Native Fullstack Engineer with a DevOps focus to support multiple engineering projects across AI-powered applications, SaaS platforms, and cloud-native solutions. This is not a traditional DevOps-only role. The role combines application engineering with infrastructure ownership: building services, APIs, automation and internal tools, while also running cloud infrastructure, deployments, observability and production operations.

The ideal profile is a strong fullstack or backend engineer, preferably TypeScript-heavy, with hands-on depth in AWS, Infrastructure as Code, containers, networking, permissions, secrets and observability. With modern AI and LLM tooling, repetitive engineering, infrastructure, debugging and automation work can be accelerated dramatically. We expect someone who uses AI-native workflows to investigate in parallel, generate and validate infrastructure changes, and support teams with high-quality execution.

What We’re Looking For
We are looking for a builder who can move across the full delivery chain: application code, infrastructure code, deployment, runtime configuration and production troubleshooting. You should be someone who:

  • Builds application software and owns the infrastructure behind it
  • Uses AI as a default development and troubleshooting workflow
  • Cares about reliability, security, automation, observability and maintainability
  • Chooses simple solutions, owns outcomes, and verifies aggressively


Your tasks

  • Fullstack Engineering: Build services, APIs, scripts, automation, internal tools and lightweight frontend functionality where useful, mainly in TypeScript
  • Infrastructure & Cloud Setup: Use IaC, ideally AWS CDK, to build pragmatic cloud patterns across containers, databases, queues, storage, networking, DNS, secrets and runtime configuration
  • ECS Fargate Operations: Deploy and troubleshoot ECS Fargate workloads, including task definitions, services, load balancers, IAM roles, logs, scaling and deployment behavior
  • Security, Observability & Troubleshooting: Handle IAM, least privilege, secrets, logs, metrics, alarms, failed deployments, configuration issues, networking problems and runtime incidents


Your profile

AI-Native Development & Operations

  • Hands-on use of Claude Code, Codex or similar advanced AI tools; Copilot-style autocomplete is not enough
  • Uses agents for development, infrastructure changes, debugging and operational investigation, while strongly reviewing and testing AI-generated code, scripts and configuration
Fullstack / Software Engineering
  • Strong fullstack or backend engineering experience, especially with TypeScript; able to build production services, APIs, scripts, tools and automation
  • Comfortable across application code, infrastructure code, deployments and runtime systems, from problem clarification to production rollout
Cloud, IaC & DevOps Operations
  • Strong IaC and AWS or similar cloud experience, ideally AWS CDK with TypeScript, across containers, ECS Fargate, networking, IAM, secrets, DNS, storage, databases, queues and runtime configuration
  • Strong observability, security and delivery judgment: logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, alarms, least privilege, deployment safety, pipeline permissions and safe developer access
  • Pragmatic production debugger with good judgment on scalability, availability, cost, security, operational trade-offs and clear English communication
Good Fit

This role is probably not the right fit if you are mainly an infrastructure admin who avoids coding, a pipeline-only DevOps profile, a pure application developer with no cloud ownership, someone who only wants predefined tickets, or someone who does not actively use and validate AI-generated infrastructure, scripts and configuration.

description: At  CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. We are looking to add a  Senior RF Engineer II  to our team. The ideal candidate has experience in board-level RF electronics design. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge RF hardware for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you.   In this position, you will be responsible for RF circuits and systems through all phases of the development process. The ideal candidate will be proficient in board-level schematic design and PCB layout of RF circuits, and system-level communications concepts such as link budgets and modulation schemes. The work will include many aspects of phased array communication systems, including RF front-ends, frequency converters and synthesizers, filters, beamformers, power dividers, and phased array antennas.   As a Cesium hardware team member, you will be responsible for RF hardware designs from initial concept through requirements definition, part selection, detailed design, analysis, manufacturing, testing, qualification, and in-orbit support of Cesium's products. Hardware design tasks will include block diagrams, detailed schematics, PCB layout and routing, simulations, and test design.   The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required. JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS A Bachelor of Science (BS) or Master of Science (MS) degree in Electrical Engineering (EE) from an accredited university or institution. 6+ years of industry experience in design and analysis of RF electronics design, analysis, test, and troubleshooting.  Experience with professional simulation tools such as CST and ADS, as well as EDA tools such Altium. Hands-on experience with lab instruments such as vector network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and oscilloscopes. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Experience with MATLAB or other programming languages. Experience in aerospace electronics design, development, and qualification. Knowledge of worst-case circuit analysis, failure method and criticality analyses, and reliability analysis. Experience with antenna design. Knowledge of EMI/EMC design and mitigation techniques. CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individual to join our team as a Principal RF Engineer I. The ideal candidate has extensive experience in board-level and system-level RF electronics design. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about developing leading-edge phased arrays for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you.
 
In this position, you will be responsible for RF circuits, modules, and systems through all phases of the development process. The ideal candidate will be proficient in board-level schematic design and PCB layout of RF circuits, system-level communications concepts such as link budgets and modulation schemes, and end-to-end RF product development. The work will include many aspects of phased array communication systems, including RF front ends, frequency converters and synthesizers, filters, beamformers, power dividers, and phased array antennas.
 
As a principal hardware team member, you will be responsible for RF system and hardware designs from initial concept through requirements definition, architecture definition, part selection, detailed design, analysis, manufacturing, testing, qualification, and in-orbit support of Cesium's products. Hardware design tasks will include block diagrams, detailed schematics, PCB layout and routing, simulations, and test design. Principal Engineers also serve as technical and professional mentors in their field and may be given the opportunity to lead company programs.
 
The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.

Successful candidates will require:
  • Bachelor of Science (BS)) degree in Electrical Engineering (EE) from an accredited university or institution.  Master of Science (MS) desired.
  • Minimum of 9 years of industry experience in design and analysis of RF electronics and systems.
  • Expert-level proficiency in professional simulation tools such as CST and ADS, as well as EDA tools such Altium.
  • Extensive hands-on experience with lab instruments such as vector network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and oscilloscopes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

    • Preferred experience includes:
  • Python or other programming languages.
  • Aerospace electronics design, development, and qualification.
  • Worst-case circuit analysis, failure method and criticality analyses, and reliability analysis.
  • Antenna design
  • EMI/EMC design and mitigation techniques.

description: At  CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Own end-to-end design of complex electronics modules and systems, from concept and architecture through schematic, layout, test, and production. Products may include high-speed digital, power electronics, and/or RF. Lead teams of hardware engineers to develop new products with multiple electronics modules. Provide subject matter expertise in support of hardware development across the company. Develop hardware architecture and write hardware requirements for systems of high complexity. Perform detailed and complete schematic design for complex boards, ranging from key components to supporting passives. Perform detailed PCB layout in Altium Designer for complex boards, often working with a PCB Drafter. Complete analysis such as worst-case circuit analysis, signal integrity analysis, and power integrity analysis. Guide analysis methodology. Develop bring-up plans and design verification plans for new hardware and complex systems. Perform bring-up and key verification testing of modules and complex integrated systems, often working with a team to complete validation. Release modules and assemblies to production, working with the Manufacturing and Test Engineering teams. Mentor junior and senior engineers to build technical understanding and professional development. Use strong working knowledge of adjacent fields, such as software and mechanical, to streamline development of complex hardware systems. Minimum of 9 years of industry or university research experience in board-level electronics design, analysis, and test. Direct experience designing high-reliability electronics and small systems for space or defense applications, including part derating, worst-case analysis, and thermal constraints. Experience owning the design phase of complex board-level electronics and small hardware systems, including architecture design, trade studies, key part selection, and detailed design. Multiple experiences delivering hardware products through production and deployment. Expertise in PCB layout and manufacturing, including high-density interconnect (HDI) stackup design, IPC standards, and industry best practices. Expertise derisking designs with board-level signal integrity and/or power integrity simulation tools such as Ansys SIwave, ADS SIPro, or Mentor Hyperlynx. Strong understanding of adjacent fields, such as software and mechanical, that contributes to judicious design of hardware system architectures. Expert-level proficiency in electronics design tools such as Altium. Extensive lab experience for bring-up and verification of new hardware, based on in-depth understanding of specialized lab equipment. Excellent written and spoken communication skills. PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Experience leading teams of hardware engineers to develop multi-module assemblies, including hardware architecture, requirements, and interconnects. title: Principal Embedded Software Engineer I
description: At  CesiumAstro , we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team. In this position, you will be responsible for low-level and high-level software in Cesium’s products through all phases of the development process. Key projects will include Linux-based single-board computers and high-reliability microcontroller systems. Cesium’s goal is to create an out-of-the-box hardware and software experience which enhances our customers’ ability to rapidly integrate our products into their systems. As a Cesium software team member, you will be responsible for software designs from concept through production, including product roadmaps, block diagrams, detailed design and coding, analysis, test, qualification, and in-orbit support. The ideal candidate will have development experience at nearly every level of the software stack, including microcontrollers, low-level drivers, board support packages (BSP), end-use applications, and user interfaces. Additionally, the ideal candidate will have experience in software testing and high-reliability qualification, as well as software engineering and software project management practices. The successful candidate will present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required. JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Designing and implementing software for embedded devices and systems, from requirements to production and commercial deployment. Designing, developing, coding, testing, debugging, and documenting system software. Reviewing code and system designs. Analyzing code for efficiency, stability, and scalability. Integrating and validating new product designs. Supporting software quality assurance and optimizing I/O performance. Providing post-production/in-orbit customer support. Location: Manchester – Hybrid working

Hours: Monday-Friday – 8:45am – 5:15pm

Package: £77,000 OTE

 

PHMG is embarking on an exciting new phase in its journey, focusing on modernizing our data capability and enhancing the way we work. This evolution presents numerous opportunities to leverage data more effectively, allowing us to better serve our customers and colleagues. As part of this growth, we are expanding our team to maximize the value from the wealth of data stored within the organisation. 

To support this vision, we are seeking a Data Scientist to join the Insights function. The Data Scientist will play a crucial role in identifying trends, uncovering patterns, and extracting valuable insights from business data. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of extracting insights from complex datasets. Sound business understanding and problem-solving abilities will also be required.  

This role is perfect for individuals passionate about applying analytical methods to foster data-driven decision-making. You will harness your analytical prowess to identify new opportunities for enhancing our business capabilities. We invite you to be part of this exciting journey, marking a new chapter of data-driven excellence at PHMG. 

 

The Role: What you will do:

  • Perform statistical analysis to uncover new commercial opportunities. 
  • Develop predictive models to forecast subscription renewals, churn rates, and revenue trends, etc. 
  • Profile our client base and prospective clients. 
  • Identify opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, and personalised offers based on customer data. 
  • Segment the client base into meaningful audiences/profiles. 
  • Support ad-hoc analysis requests from the business, providing rapid insights for decision-making. 
  • Collaborate closely with the Data Engineering team to improve data models. 
  • Present insights and findings to stakeholders in clear, actionable ways. 

 

This is an exciting role for a Data Scientist who has:

  • Proven experience as a Data Scientist, ideally within a sales or commercial environment. 
  • Strong knowledge of data analysis techniques, statistical methods, and machine learning. 
  • Proficiency in a Python, specifically scikit-learn and pandas. 
  • Experience in using MS Fabric desirable. 
  • SQL skills would be beneficial. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 
  • A can-do attitude and is a self-starter. 
  • Comfortable working collaboratively within a cross-functional team. 
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present complex insights in a simple, clear way. 
  • Proven track record of using insights to drive business change. 

 

The Department: 

The Technology Department serves as the central hub for data engineering and insights across our organization. Our department operates as a unified force, cultivating a culture that empowers analysts and engineers to excel.  

PHMG's CTO recognizes that effective business intelligence is not the sole responsibility of one team but a capability that should permeate the entire organization. To achieve this, we view the data functions as an enabler of self-serve analytics, accomplished through robust data management, governance, and education initiatives. This approach ensures that business intelligence is accessible and leveraged across the organization, driving data-driven decision-making at all levels. 

 

Why PHMG Tech?  

The IT, Data & Engineering functions within PHMG has been going through a digital transformation, changing how we deliver value to our business. A big part of this change is fostering a culture of being open and honest, collaborating, having fun and enabling psychological safety.   

We want to create a place for teams to do their best work, and you will have the opportunity to influence our decisions, help define standards across the teams and contribute to a healthy and happy working environment. 

 

 

About PHMG:

Established in 1998, PHMG has grown from a renowned Manchester-based business to the world's leading audio branding agency – working with 36,000 clients in 54 countries across the globe. This expansive client list includes household names of the calibre of Samsung, Audi and Adidas, as well as SMEs in every sector of the global market. We give each of them a stellar production that combines creative copy, world-class voice artistry and an exclusive Brand-Sound-Track™ – strengthening their business identity in the most memorable, emotive way.

Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Senior Data Analyst

Location: Weybridge, Surrey, United Kingdom

 

Established in 2004, Inside Ideas Group is a rapidly growing global agency network that helps clients drive their businesses forward from the inside. We partner with over 300 clients in more than 40 countries, delivering ideas, technology and creativity that make a measurable impact. 

As part of The Brandtech Group, we are pioneers in using advanced AI technologies to transform the way we create, optimise and deliver work. Our AI capabilities enhance efficiency, support smart decision making and unlock new levels of creativity for our teams and clients. 

We are now looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our onsite team supporting in London. 

About the Role 

As the Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering insight that drives improvements across the full commercial ecosystem spanning customer experience on, retailer investment effectiveness, marketing and sales performance, and the broader post-purchase, onboarding and promotional landscape. 

A core part of your remit will be the design, build and ongoing management of a marketing and sales performance dashboard, underpinned by Google BigQuery and delivered in Looker Studio. This will serve as a critical decision-making tool for marketing, e-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets. 

Alongside this, you will analyse customer journeys, benchmark competitors, oversee content performance and support the planning and execution of onboarding and e-commerce promotions using platforms like GWI to create digital personas and audience profiles. 

You will collaborate closely with CX, marketing, product and e-commerce teams as well as HQ and local market stakeholders to ensure insight informs decisions at every stage. 

This role requires strong analytical capability, expertise in data modelling and SQL, and the ability to translate complex commercial questions into dashboard logic and actionable recommendations. 

What You Will Be Doing 

Marketing & Sales Performance Analytics  

  • Design, build and maintain a marketing and sales performance dashboard in Looker Studio, underpinned by BigQuery, combining sell-out sales data, market volume and share data, and campaign activity logs. 
  • Define the underlying data model, transform source files and design the reporting layer to support consistent, scalable KPI delivery. 
  • Identify and quantify the impact of retailer investment, including uplift in sales and market share during campaign periods. 
  • Analyse correlations between campaign activity and commercial performance to determine which marketing levers are most effective. 
  • Measure and report on halo effects across products and retailers resulting from promotional and campaign activity. 
  • Define and calculate key performance metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Work with GFK or other syndicated market data sources to enrich performance analysis with market volume and share context. 

Customer Experience & Digital Analytics 

  • Conduct analysis of the current customer experience, including user behaviour, content and campaign performance and conversion pathways. 
  • Benchmark key customer journeys against competitor websites to identify gaps and opportunities. 
  • Provide regular insight into paid promotions, post-purchase experience and customer satisfaction trends. 
  • Support planning, optimisation and operational management of post-purchase and onboarding experience. 
  • Analyse content utilisation, engagement and drop-off points, and recommend enhancements. 
  • Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation. 
  • Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates. 
  • Reporting, Dashboards & Stakeholder Insight 
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports and ad hoc analyses across customer experience, onboarding, e-commerce, retail performance and promotion activity. 
  • Translate data into clear insights that guide decision-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams. 
  • Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes. 
  • Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning. 

What You Need to Be Great in This Role 

Essential 

  • Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments. 
  • Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design. 
  • Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance. 
  • Demonstrable experience combining sell-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight. 
  • Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels. 
  • Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e-commerce KPIs. 
  • Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar. 
  • Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non-technical audiences. 
  • Experience working with multi-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions. 
  • A passion for data-driven decision-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows. 

Preferred: 

  • Proficiency in Python (pandas) for data transformation, automation and workflow scripting. 
  • Broader experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including automating data ingestion and transformation workflows. 
  • Experience working in retail, e-commerce or retailer media environments. 
  • Familiarity with GfK or other syndicated market data sources. 
  • Experience with additional BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

raw.description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

 

Role:  Account Director (4 Months FTC)

Location: Remote + UK, London with 2-3 days a week in Slough  

 

ROLE MISSION  

Are you looking for an opportunity to innovate with brands? Involving the development of strategy, creative concepts, content and campaign implementation? 

  

This role will be underpinned by passion and ambition, and those with experience in leading digital content and social campaigns within a creative agency will have an advantage. 

  

The Account Director is responsible for running creative and production processes and working alongside our team to drive a project from brief to delivery. They have a good understanding of digital disciplines and are confident working in agency teams.  

  

You will need to be great with strategy, creative and account teams alike, hardworking and passionate about creativity and producing the best product you can. The process is key, and someone who really respects and understands that, although creative needs freedom, it also needs to follow a framework and process to allow it to thrive. 

  

This role will be underpinned by passion and ambition, and those with experience in running digital content and social campaigns within a creative agency will have an advantage. 

  

What we want to see is a proven track record of producing multiple complex projects. You should have meticulous attention to detail, understand the importance of the profitability of your projects for the agency and you will have proven yourself as a safe pair of hands on the day-to-day running of multiple prestigious projects. 

  

Most important, this role requires a courteous, positive and high-energy individual with great people skills. We value hard work, and we want to have fun doing it.   

   

THIS ROLE IS RIGHT FOR YOU IF... 

You can say you have: 

  • Experience managing digital and integrated campaigns in a creative and production agency.  
  • Strong track record in executing campaigns across multiple platforms in particular social media. 
  • Used to leveraging the experience of video and photography Producers as part of a holistic approach to campaign execution. 
  • Previous experience of Project Budget Management and Scheduling. 
  • Previous experience of Resource and Production services sourcing. 
  • Excellent client engagement skills with the ability to proactively organize and influence clients and build strong and effective working relationships. 
  • Have a positive, can-do outlook, willing to leverage experience to provide the best solution for each project you own. 

 

  • Be willing to share your experience where relevant and when it adds to the offering to the client. 
  • A pro-active and can do approach and used to moving at speed to deliver effective work and client solutions. 
  • Be financially conscientious when managing the delivery of a project, ensuring all relevant parties are aware of the financial implications of delays, additional amends and re-briefs. 
  • Be able to verify the qualitative and quantitative output of a project against the project objectives. 
  • Act as the first line of contact and digital expert for the team in the life cycle of a digital project. 
  • Understanding of how to integrate with a client-side team whilst maintaining a top-tier agency service. 
  • Be unafraid to ask questions and have an innate ability to identify and manage project risk. 
  • Knowledge of creating content for CMSs and E-commerce would be a bonus. 

 

 

ABOUT THE TEAM YOU WILL BE JOINING 

Working in partnership with our clients marketing Durex team, our team of 8 will work across the following; 

  

  • Strategy - social & content 
  • Creative, copywriting & design 
  • Editorial & publishing, distribution 
  • Content production & post 
  • Data & analytics 
  • Community management 
  • Online content management 

 

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING IN YOUR ROLE 

 

Client Relationship 

  • Work in true collaboration with the client and be responsible for Brand Guardianship on their projects to ensure the client experience is as positive as possible. 
  • Be the trusted advisor of the client, ensuring that you are the go-to and most trusted person on the account. 
  • Own the execution of projects and ensure client satisfaction is maintained throughout the project. 
  • Anticipate and manage any issues by staying in close contact with the client and truly understanding what they need. 

Project Set Up 

  • Taking overall ownership of integrated creative projects from brief to fulfillment. 
  • Working closely with strategy and account teams in preparing social strategy and milestones for the client. 
  • Liaising with clients to determine campaign scope and produce estimates and schedules. 
  • Identifying, exploiting and managing ad hoc opportunities when they arise. 
  • Working with account teams to agree and create timing plans and estimates within our internal Traffic system. 
  • Estimating complex, cross-platform social projects. 
  • Take overall financial control of their projects, including profitability, accuracy of forecasting, as well as fee negotiation, providing regular and timely reports to the management. 

 

Project Delivery 

  • Schedule projects in line with the correct internal resource and help to source external resource where necessary. 
  • Ensure projects follow the agency process and are completed on time and on budget. 
  • Work closely with Digital / TV / Print Producers to unify skills needed to execute integrated campaigns. 
  • Motivate and manage teams under tight deadlines. 
  • Educate and manage internal stakeholders in relevant production processes where necessary. 
  • Drive efficiency and creative excellence at all times. 

  

Reporting  

  • Ensures they understand how to report and manage operational income for their projects in a timely and accurate manner. 
  • Escalates any queries concerning invoicing, or estimates provided by the studio on their projects to the  

 

ABOUT OUR COMPANY 

Many companies talk about having a unique and thriving business model, but the Inside Ideas Group truly does. What IIG does is provide clients with dedicated, on-site agencies that are built from the ground up. It's a dynamic, fast paced, solutions-focused start-up environment that brings client and agency closer together to co-create more effective and efficient work. 

 

These dedicated agencies live and work right at the very heart of our client's organisation. Delivering precisely the skills and capacity they require, complemented by additional talent from our whole business on everything from planning to execution. 

 

This business model creates a truly entrepreneurial, fast paced, challenging and rewarding environment to work in and has been recognised as the 6th best agency to work for in the UK.  

 

 

OUR VALUES 

We are a company built on our values; we have given you a brief overview below but would love to tell you more. 

Be Ambitious to succeed 

Be Imaginative to push the boundaries of what's possible 

Be Inspirational to do ground breaking work 

Be always learning and listening to understand 

Be Results-focused to exceed expectations 

 

As an employer, we are committed to ensuring representation of people from all backgrounds regardless of their gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, race, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, or any other aspect which makes them unique. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds to apply and would encourage you to let us know if there are steps, we can take to ensure that your recruitment process enables you to present yourself in a way that makes you comfortable.
