Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Data Analyst

Location: Weybridge, Surrey, United Kingdom

 

Established in 2004, Inside Ideas Group is a rapidly growing global agency network that helps clients drive their businesses forward from the inside. We partner with over 300 clients in more than 40 countries, delivering ideas, technology and creativity that make a measurable impact. 

As part of The Brandtech Group, we are pioneers in using advanced AI technologies to transform the way we create, optimise and deliver work. Our AI capabilities enhance efficiency, support smart decision making and unlock new levels of creativity for our teams and clients. 

We are now looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our onsite team supporting in London. 

About the Role 

As the Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering insight that drives improvements across the full commercial ecosystem spanning customer experience on, retailer investment effectiveness, marketing and sales performance, and the broader post-purchase, onboarding and promotional landscape. 

A core part of your remit will be the design, build and ongoing management of a marketing and sales performance dashboard, underpinned by Google BigQuery and delivered in Looker Studio. This will serve as a critical decision-making tool for marketing, e-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets. 

Alongside this, you will analyse customer journeys, benchmark competitors, oversee content performance and support the planning and execution of onboarding and e-commerce promotions using platforms like GWI to create digital personas and audience profiles. 

You will collaborate closely with CX, marketing, product and e-commerce teams as well as HQ and local market stakeholders to ensure insight informs decisions at every stage. 

This role requires strong analytical capability, expertise in data modelling and SQL, and the ability to translate complex commercial questions into dashboard logic and actionable recommendations. 

What You Will Be Doing 

Marketing & Sales Performance Analytics  

  • Design, build and maintain a marketing and sales performance dashboard in Looker Studio, underpinned by BigQuery, combining sell-out sales data, market volume and share data, and campaign activity logs. 
  • Define the underlying data model, transform source files and design the reporting layer to support consistent, scalable KPI delivery. 
  • Identify and quantify the impact of retailer investment, including uplift in sales and market share during campaign periods. 
  • Analyse correlations between campaign activity and commercial performance to determine which marketing levers are most effective. 
  • Measure and report on halo effects across products and retailers resulting from promotional and campaign activity. 
  • Define and calculate key performance metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Work with GFK or other syndicated market data sources to enrich performance analysis with market volume and share context. 

Customer Experience & Digital Analytics 

  • Conduct analysis of the current customer experience, including user behaviour, content and campaign performance and conversion pathways. 
  • Benchmark key customer journeys against competitor websites to identify gaps and opportunities. 
  • Provide regular insight into paid promotions, post-purchase experience and customer satisfaction trends. 
  • Support planning, optimisation and operational management of post-purchase and onboarding experience. 
  • Analyse content utilisation, engagement and drop-off points, and recommend enhancements. 
  • Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation. 
  • Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates. 
  • Reporting, Dashboards & Stakeholder Insight 
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports and ad hoc analyses across customer experience, onboarding, e-commerce, retail performance and promotion activity. 
  • Translate data into clear insights that guide decision-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams. 
  • Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes. 
  • Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning. 

What You Need to Be Great in This Role 

Essential 

  • Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments. 
  • Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design. 
  • Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance. 
  • Demonstrable experience combining sell-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight. 
  • Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels. 
  • Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e-commerce KPIs. 
  • Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar. 
  • Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non-technical audiences. 
  • Experience working with multi-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions. 
  • A passion for data-driven decision-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows. 

Preferred: 

  • Proficiency in Python (pandas) for data transformation, automation and workflow scripting. 
  • Broader experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including automating data ingestion and transformation workflows. 
  • Experience working in retail, e-commerce or retailer media environments. 
  • Familiarity with GfK or other syndicated market data sources.

raw.description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Data Analyst

Location: Weybridge, Surrey, United Kingdom

 

Established in 2004, Inside Ideas Group is a rapidly growing global agency network that helps clients drive their businesses forward from the inside. We partner with over 300 clients in more than 40 countries, delivering ideas, technology and creativity that make a measurable impact. 

As part of The Brandtech Group, we are pioneers in using advanced AI technologies to transform the way we create, optimise and deliver work. Our AI capabilities enhance efficiency, support smart decision making and unlock new levels of creativity for our teams and clients. 

We are now looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our onsite team supporting in London. 

About the Role 

As the Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering insight that drives improvements across the full commercial ecosystem spanning customer experience on, retailer investment effectiveness, marketing and sales performance, and the broader post-purchase, onboarding and promotional landscape. 

A core part of your remit will be the design, build and ongoing management of a marketing and sales performance dashboard, underpinned by Google BigQuery and delivered in Looker Studio. This will serve as a critical decision-making tool for marketing, e-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets. 

Alongside this, you will analyse customer journeys, benchmark competitors, oversee content performance and support the planning and execution of onboarding and e-commerce promotions using platforms like GWI to create digital personas and audience profiles. 

You will collaborate closely with CX, marketing, product and e-commerce teams as well as HQ and local market stakeholders to ensure insight informs decisions at every stage. 

This role requires strong analytical capability, expertise in data modelling and SQL, and the ability to translate complex commercial questions into dashboard logic and actionable recommendations. 

What You Will Be Doing 

Marketing & Sales Performance Analytics  

  • Design, build and maintain a marketing and sales performance dashboard in Looker Studio, underpinned by BigQuery, combining sell-out sales data, market volume and share data, and campaign activity logs. 
  • Define the underlying data model, transform source files and design the reporting layer to support consistent, scalable KPI delivery. 
  • Identify and quantify the impact of retailer investment, including uplift in sales and market share during campaign periods. 
  • Analyse correlations between campaign activity and commercial performance to determine which marketing levers are most effective. 
  • Measure and report on halo effects across products and retailers resulting from promotional and campaign activity. 
  • Define and calculate key performance metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Work with GFK or other syndicated market data sources to enrich performance analysis with market volume and share context. 

Customer Experience & Digital Analytics 

  • Conduct analysis of the current customer experience, including user behaviour, content and campaign performance and conversion pathways. 
  • Benchmark key customer journeys against competitor websites to identify gaps and opportunities. 
  • Provide regular insight into paid promotions, post-purchase experience and customer satisfaction trends. 
  • Support planning, optimisation and operational management of post-purchase and onboarding experience. 
  • Analyse content utilisation, engagement and drop-off points, and recommend enhancements. 
  • Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation. 
  • Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates. 
  • Reporting, Dashboards & Stakeholder Insight 
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports and ad hoc analyses across customer experience, onboarding, e-commerce, retail performance and promotion activity. 
  • Translate data into clear insights that guide decision-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams. 
  • Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes. 
  • Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning. 

What You Need to Be Great in This Role 

Essential 

  • Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments. 
  • Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design. 
  • Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance. 
  • Demonstrable experience combining sell-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight. 
  • Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels. 
  • Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e-commerce KPIs. 
  • Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar. 
  • Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non-technical audiences. 
  • Experience working with multi-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions. 
  • A passion for data-driven decision-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows. 

Preferred: 

  • Proficiency in Python (pandas) for data transformation, automation and workflow scripting. 
  • Broader experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including automating data ingestion and transformation workflows. 
  • Experience working in retail, e-commerce or retailer media environments. 
  • Familiarity with GfK or other syndicated market data sources. 
  • Experience with additional BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI. 

Our Values 

Be Ambitious to succeed Be Imaginative to push the boundaries of what's possible Be Inspirational to do groundbreaking work Be always learning and listening to understand Be Results-focused to exceed expectations Be actively pro-inclusive and anti-racist across our community, clients and creations

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you’ll own the infrastructure that powers our global SaaS platform: designing for scale, building for reliability, and driving the kind of security-first culture that keeps us ahead of the curve. If you thrive in complex cloud environments, love solving hard problems, and want your work to have real, tangible impact — this is the role.</p> <p class="p2"><strong>What makes us different?</strong></p> <p class="p1">Duetto is the hospitality industry’s leading revenue management platform, founded in 2012 by former Wynn Resorts executives who knew the industry needed better technology. We built the world’s first Revenue &amp; Profit Operating System — a suite of tools (GameChanger, ScoreBoard, BlockBuster, Advance and more) that goes beyond room pricing to give hotels, resorts and casinos a complete picture of their revenue and profitability.</p> <p class="p1">Trusted by clients ranging from independent boutique hotels to global chains, we’ve been named the #1 Revenue Management Software by HotelTechAwards four years running and the #1 Best Place to Work in Hotel Tech in 2025. Backed by GrowthCurve Capital since 2024, we’re accelerating our investment in AI — and we’re genuinely passionate about the industry we serve. We build products we’re proud of, for customers we care about.</p> <p class="p3"><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li4">Design and implement robust, scalable AWS infrastructure — supporting key system migrations, platform growth, and the reliability our customers depend on.</li> <li class="li4">Own the reliability, performance, and security of our production environment: high uptime, rapid incident resolution, and proactive capacity planning.</li> <li class="li4">Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, Terragrunt, and Chef.</li> <li class="li4">Monitor system health using enterprise observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, DataDog), defining metrics and response playbooks that get ahead of incidents before they happen.</li> <li class="li4">Lead security-first practices across the infrastructure estate — proactively addressing vulnerabilities and driving SOC 2 compliance.</li> <li class="li4">Partner with engineering teams to integrate operational requirements into the development lifecycle and align on architecture decisions.</li> <li class="li4">Champion AI adoption within DevOps and SRE workflows, evaluating tooling that increases team velocity and reduces toil.</li> <li class="li4">Respond to on-call incidents with urgency — troubleshoot complex issues, lead detailed root cause analyses, and implement fixes that prevent recurrence.</li> </ul> <p class="p3"><strong>What we’re looking for</strong></p> <p class="p5"><strong>You may be a great fit if you have:</strong></p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li4">5+ years in a DevOps, SRE, or infrastructure engineering role.</li> <li class="li4">Hands-on AWS experience across IAM, VPC, EC2, ELB, RDS, S3, Lambda, API Gateway, Secrets Manager, KMS, CloudWatch, and CloudTrail — including multi-account management and SSO.</li> <li class="li4">Proficiency with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code, plus experience with configuration management tools like Chef or Ansible.</li> <li class="li4">Experience with CI/CD tooling including GitHub, GitHub Actions, JFrog Artifactory, and Jenkins, with familiarity with GitOps methodologies.</li> <li class="li4">Strong working knowledge of enterprise monitoring platforms — Prometheus, Grafana, or DataDog.</li> <li>Familiarity with Windows Server, SQL Server, IIS, and .NET environments.</li> <li class="li4">Solid troubleshooting skills and a track record of leading root cause analyses and implementing durable fixes.</li> <li class="li4">Proficiency reading Java, Ruby, Bash/Zsh, HCL, Python, and JavaScript.</li> <li class="li4">Experience with SOC 2 compliance and security-first infrastructure practices.</li> <li class="li4">Comfort with a weekly on-call rotation.</li> </ul> <p class="p5"><strong>Strong candidates may also have:</strong></p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li4">Experience with container and orchestration technologies — Docker, ECS, or EKS.</li> <li class="li4">Experience migrating workloads from on-prem or colocation environments to AWS.</li> <li class="li4">Experience administering and synchronising MongoDB replica sets.</li> <li class="li4">Knowledge of ISO 27001, Layer 7 load balancing, or Terragrunt.</li> <li class="li4">Background in hospitality technology.</li> <li class="li4">A degree in Computer Science or a related field — or equivalent experience.</li> </ul> <p class="p3"><strong>Why Duetto?</strong></p> <ul class="ul1"> <li class="li4"><strong>Infrastructure that matters — </strong>your work directly underpins a platform that hotel operators around the world rely on every day. The stakes are real, and so is the satisfaction.</li> <li class="li4"><strong>AI is how we work — </strong>we’re not just talking about AI adoption; we’re actively investing in it across every function, including DevOps. You’ll have space to evaluate and implement tooling that makes a genuine difference.</li> <li class="li4"><strong>A team that moves fast — </strong>you’ll report into the Senior DevOps Manager and work alongside engineers who are serious about craft, reliability, and continuous improvement.</li> <li class="li4"><strong>Growth with purpose — </strong>backed by GrowthCurve Capital, we’re scaling our platform and our team. There’s a lot being built here, and senior engineers have real influence over how it’s done.</li> <li class="li4"><strong>Come as you are — </strong>we’re a diverse, distributed team that values different perspectives and builds inclusively.</li> </ul> <p class="p3"><strong>The details</strong></p> <p class="p4"><span class="s1"><strong>Location:<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp; </span></strong></span>Croatia</p> <p class="p6"><strong>Work model:<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp; </span></strong><span class="s2">Remote</span></p> <p class="p4"><span class="s1"><strong>Reports to:<span class="Apple-converted-space">&nbsp; </span></strong></span>Senior DevOps Manager</p> <p class="p7">&nbsp;</p> <p class="p8"><em>Duetto is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.</em></p> <p class="p3"><strong>Sound like you?</strong></p> <p class="p4">We’d love to hear from you — even if you don’t tick every box. Diverse perspectives and non-traditional paths make our team stronger. Apply and let’s talk.</p> <p class="p4">&nbsp;</p> <p class="p4">&nbsp;</p> <p class="p4">#LI-REMOTE</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?</strong></p> <p>Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.</p></div><p><strong>Location:</strong> London / Hybrid<br><strong>Duration:</strong> 6-12 Months&nbsp;<br><strong>Day Rate:</strong> £340 - £360 per day&nbsp;<br><strong>Engagement Method</strong>: Umbrella/PAYE&nbsp;<br><strong>Role Overview:</strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a <strong>Senior Digital Designer</strong> to join our Creative Services team for an initial 6-12 month<strong> </strong>period. The Global Creative Team is seeking a an experienced, hands-on, creative, and detail-focused Senior Digital Experience Designer to join forces with our team &amp; contribute their design experiences and co-lead the delivery for our creative project marketing touchpoints worldwide.</p> <p>This role will report to the Sr Design Manager to liaise with other cross-functional departments and deliver Digital creative for mid to high complexity projects on schedule and on-brand. Our work is seen by millions, from national retail environments to limited edition hardware, to exclusive game titles, to official PlayStation® apparel that fans wait hours in line to get their hands on.</p> <p>Serve as one of the design leads for key PlayStation.com and CRM projects, while supporting our expanding workload across a wide range of initiatives, including game / hardware launches, brand and sales campaigns, emails, new business initiatives, UI/UX support, and other creative projects. Support the development and enhancement of SIE brand best practices, production techniques, and workflows.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll be doing:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Co-Lead the day-to-day digital design &amp; production tasks of layout, template-building, edits, and final file prep for PlayStation.com &amp; CRM.</li> <li>Define page design and user flows for new &amp; existing pages across the end-to-end journey</li> <li>Take direction from other design leads and support and oversee the work of more junior members</li> <li>Collaborate and communicate with design leadership, project managers, and traffic coordinators.</li> <li>Work with cross functional teams to ensure the work and production quality meets PlayStation® brand and design standards.</li> <li>Present design efforts in front of small groups, over email, and/or through visual presentations to a wide audience of various backgrounds.</li> <li>Take initiatives to better understand industry and competitor approaches through in-store, online, and design publication research.</li> <li>Develop Localized artwork for PlayStation.com &amp; CRM</li> <li>Rework game and hardware assets into various banners for PlayStation.com &amp; CRM, to meet the standard requirements for publishing.</li> <li>Support updating Marketing brand and technical guidelines.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we’re looking for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience in digital and production design within a dynamic marketing environment, gained either in-house or at an agency.</li> <li>Strong experience designing web, mobile and CRM layouts in Figma using established design-system components, with a proven ability to optimize user journeys for clarity, efficiency, and conversion</li> <li>Expert knowledge of Figma &amp; Adobe Creative Cloud &amp; (Photoshop, Illustrator, etc.).</li> <li>Design theory, including layout, color, typography, hierarchy, as well as current design trends.</li> <li>Ability to conceptualize in quick, broad strokes and big, creative ways, but able to see ideas through to the last details of file organization and clean-up, adhering to template specs, proofing content, and spellchecking.</li> <li>Experience designing across a wide variety of digital media and formats.</li> <li>Ability to follow design instructions and implement style guides.</li> <li>Ability to work in a challenging, fast-paced, and dynamic corporate environment while staying deadline-focused on multiple projects with composure and ease.</li> <li>Flexible, team player, devoid of ego, with enthusiasm for collaboration and a willingness to take direction and offer own insights.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p class="p1">Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.</p> <p class="p1">Please refer to our&nbsp;<a href="https://www.playstation.com/legal/careers-privacy-notice/" target="_blank">Candidate Privacy Notice</a>&nbsp;for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.</p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity Statement:</strong></p> <p><em>Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.</em></p> <p><em>We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><em>Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
